title: Finance Assistant with AAT Study Support
company: Axon Moore Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Finance Assistant Bradford AAT Training and development plan £25,000
Are you looking to build a career in finance with a business that will support your development?

I am recruiting for a Finance Assistant / Purchase Ledger Administrator to join an established and successful business based in Bradford. This is a great opportunity for someone with some purchase ledger or finance experience who is keen to develop their skills and work towards an AAT qualification.

The role
Working as part of the finance team, you'll be responsible for ensuring financial transactions are processed accurately and efficiently, while supporting the wider finance function.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing purchase ledger transactions accurately and on time
- Processing personal expenses and bank transactions
- Investigating and resolving purchase ledger queries
- Working with the wider team to ensure issues are dealt with promptly
- Assisting with the preparation of monthly management accounts
- Providing a professional and customer-focused service
- Supporting the finance team with general duties as required

About you
We're looking for someone who is numerate, organised and keen to develop a career in finance.
You'll ideally have:
- Some previous purchase ledger or finance administration experience
- Good communication skills
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Good Excel and general IT skills
- The ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines
- A positive, customer-focused approach
- GCSE Maths and English at Grade C or above (or equivalent)
- A genuine interest in progressing within finance and the ambition to study AAT.

What's on offer?
- £25,000 salary
- Permanent, full-time position
- Fully funded training package
- Support towards AAT studies
- 23 days' holiday plus bank holidays, increasing with service
- On-site parking
- Discretionary annual bonus
- Pension
- Healthcare and life assurance options
- On-site gym
- 8am-5pm working hours with a one-hour lunch break
- Office-based role with a flexible approach

If you're looking for a role where you can gain solid finance experience, develop your skills and work towards a professional qualification, this could be a great next step.

title: Interim Finance Officer
description:
Interim Finance Officer

Location: Bradford
Salary: £28,000 - £33,000 per annum, depending on experience
Contract: 6-month fixed-term contract, with potential to become permanent
Hours: Full-time, 1 day a week in the office

We are recruiting for a Finance Officer to join a busy finance team in Bradford on an initial six-month fixed-term contract, with the potential for the role to become permanent for the right person.

This is a varied finance position covering accounts payable, accounts receivable and general ledger activities, making it an excellent opportunity for either an experienced Finance Officer or a high-potential junior finance professional looking to develop their career.

The Role

Working as part of the finance team, you will support a broad range of day-to-day financial processes and help ensure transactions are processed accurately and efficiently.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Processing accounts payable and accounts receivable transactions.
- Supporting general ledger activities and maintaining accurate financial records.
- Preparing and processing payment runs.
- Completing bank and balance sheet reconciliations.
- Assisting with double-entry bookkeeping.
- Uploading and processing housing benefit schedules.
- Supporting the wider finance team with day-to-day accounting requirements.
- Investigating and resolving financial queries where required.
- Ensuring financial information is accurate, complete and processed within agreed timescales.
- Contributing to the ongoing improvement of finance processes and systems.

About You

We are open to considering candidates at different stages of their finance career.

We're particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate:
- Experience within a finance administration, accounts or Finance Officer position.
- Exposure to accounts payable and/or accounts receivable.
- Good knowledge of Excel and confidence working with financial data.
- Ideally, experience using Excel lookups and pivot tables, or the aptitude to develop these skills quickly.
- Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
- The initiative to identify issues and find solutions rather than simply follow processes.
- A proactive and collaborative approach to working.

Experience within the housing sector would be advantageous, as would experience of HomeMaster, although neither is essential.

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking for a role that offers both variety and development.

For a junior candidate, the position provides the opportunity to broaden your experience across AP, AR and general ledger functions while developing your technical finance skills.

For a more experienced Finance Officer, the role offers the opportunity to take ownership of a varied workload and use your existing systems and process knowledge to make an immediate contribution.

The initial contract is for six months, with the potential for the position to become permanent for the successful candidate.

If you're an ambitious junior finance professional or an experienced Finance Officer looking for your next opportunity in Bradford, we'd be keen to hear from you.

title: Service Administrator
company: Bradford District Care NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Bradford District Care NHS Foundation Trust
description: Bradford District Care NHS Foundation Trust's Hub Teams are multi-disciplined teams of administrators dealing with enquiries from patients, service users, carers and clinicians. The service is delivered in an Inpatient Hospital Environment providing admin support to Clinical Teams Monday - Friday, operating core office hours. The Administrator role will provide efficient, effective and high quality clerical support to a range of identified professionals within clinical inpatient services. The role requires someone who is able to travel between Bradford Royal infirmary and Lynfield Mount Hospital Closing- 20th September 2026 Shortlisting- 21st September 2026 Interview- 29th September 2026 (provisionally) The Administrator role will provide an efficient, effective, and high-quality administrative support to health and social care professionals and service users/patients within a community based or district wide team. Service Administrator roles support Medics and/or Clinical Teams, these roles will be supporting the Inpatient Flow Management team and ALPS service for 12 months. Please read the attached Job description and person specification for more details about this role. Right to Work in the UK Applicants should be aware that for any individual who requires a visa to work in the UK, the Trust provides sponsorship for registered healthcare practitioner roles only. This is an essential requirement of the role, and the Trust is unable to offer you a role if you are unable to meet Trust requirements for sponsorship and Home Office requirements for a visa. Prior to your appointment you will be asked to provide confirmation of your right to work and reside in the UK. During your continued employment with the Trust, you have a personal responsibility to notify your manager as soon as possible should there be any changes to your right to work status. Regrettably, if the role is not eligible for sponsorship under the Trusts eligibility criteria, the Trust are unable to extend your employment beyond the expiration of your current visa. The Trust is not responsible or liable for ensuring that your employment continues after this period. As a condition of continuous employment, it essential you maintain the legal right to work in the United Kingdom throughout the duration of your employment with Bradford District Care NHS Foundation Trust (BDCFT). Any change in your right-to-work status, including but not limited to visa expiration, revocation, or denial of renewal, may impact your eligibility for employment with the Trust. It is your responsibility to promptly inform your Line Manager of any changes in your right-to-work status immediately and to provide necessary documentation for verification purposes. Failure to obtain or renew your visa in a timely manner is a breach of employment conditions and will result in termination of your employment. We appreciate your attention to this matter and your commitment to fulfilling this requirement promptly.

title: Receptionist
location: Shipley, BD18 3EG, Shipley, BD18 3EE, Bradford, BD10 9AZ
description: As a key member of the Patient Services team you will be responsible for providing an efficient reception function that includes some specific administration duties.
